conditions: Applies to the report’s dated SETL2 description.
limitations: The restriction concerns using a procedure itself as a value. Ordinary direct calls and procedure return values have separate rules.

triggers: Reevaluate source corrections, revised applicability, or material contrary evidence.

statement: Snyder’s SETL2 report describes procedures with only read-only formal parameters as first-class objects. A procedure with any read-write or write-only formal parameter lacks an assignable procedure value.
